result.note: Mainly a corporate launch; tested only the payment-network angle, as RuPay is India's domestic card network.

questions.prompt: As reported in October 2026, Apple Pay launched in India through Axis Bank. Its initial launch covered Axis credit cards on which card networks?
questions.explain: The launch initially covers Axis credit cards on the Visa and Mastercard networks. Cards on RuPay, India's domestic network, are ineligible. Axis is India's fourth-largest credit card issuer, with 16.3 million of the country's 124 million cards as of August.
